verdicts.reason: A uses a sensible left-to-right banner layout: the can is on the left, and the logo, headline, subcopy and CTA sit in one right-hand column. Its flaws: the NEW FLAVOR badge and subcopy are tiny, the logo is very small, the can is jammed toward the top edge, and the large circle sits behind the copy. B is clearly broken. The subcopy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column, and the headline breaks so that 'Light' is left alone on its own line, crowding the top edge. The CTA is pushed against the right edge, and the logo has been moved down to the bottom-left at a tiny size, which wrecks the reading order. The badge is shrunk to an illegible size inside the circle.
